title: Currenc Group Strengthens Web3 and AI Expansion with Appointment of Kelly Leung as Venture Partner
summary: SINGAPORE, May 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Currenc Group Inc. (Nasdaq: CURR) (“Currenc” or the “Company”), a fintech pioneer empowering financial institutions worldwide with artificial intelligence (“AI”) solutions, today announced the appointment of Kelly Leung as Venture Partner, effective immediately, as the Company continues expanding its strategic initiatives across Web3, AI infrastructure, and digital asset markets. Ms. Leung will advise the Company’s board and executive leadership on strategic partnerships, partner network expansion, platform adoption initiatives, and additional growth initiatives across Web3, AI, and digital asset sectors. Ms. Leung brings over 25 years of experience in global strategic alliances, cross-border business development, and Web3 ecosystem development.
